title: UNIT 1 Back to School
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

Welcome back to school!
Nice to see you again!
Did you have a good summer holiday?
Yes, I did. I went to the beach.

LET'S CHANT
Back to school, back to school.
New books, new pens, new class.
Back to school, back to school.
Let's learn and grow together!

LET'S PLAY
Summer holiday sharing.

I went to Shanghai.
I visited my grandparents.
I read many books.
I learned to swim.

LET'S TRY
Listen and write.

I went to Shanghai.
I visited my grandparents.
I read many books.
I learned to swim.
subject: 英语
translation:
第一单元 回到学校

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

欢迎回到学校！
很高兴再见到你！
你暑假过得愉快吗？
是的，我去了海滩。

一起来吟唱
回到学校，回到学校。
新书，新笔，新班级。
回到学校，回到学校。
让我们一起学习和成长！

一起玩一玩
暑假分享。

我去了上海。
我看了爷爷奶奶。
我读了很多书。
我学会了游泳。

一起来试试
听录音，写一写。

我去了上海。
我看了爷爷奶奶。
我读了很多书。
我学会了游泳。

title: UNIT 2 Good Habits
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

What good habits do you have?
I brush my teeth twice a day.
I do my homework on time.
I eat fruits and vegetables.

LET'S CHANT
Good habits, good habits,
keep us healthy every day.
Good habits, good habits,
help us learn and play!

LET'S PLAY
Habit checklist.

Get up early.
Make your bed.
Wash your hands before eating.
Exercise every day.

LET'S TRY
Listen and tick.

I brush my teeth every day.
I do my homework on time.
I eat healthy food.
I exercise every day.
subject: 英语
translation:
第二单元 好习惯

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

你有什么好习惯？
我每天刷牙两次。
我按时做作业。
我吃水果和蔬菜。

一起来吟唱
好习惯，好习惯，
让我们每天都健康。
好习惯，好习惯，
帮助我们学习和玩耍！

一起玩一玩
习惯检查表。

早起。
整理床铺。
饭前洗手。
每天锻炼。

一起来试试
听录音，打勾。

我每天刷牙。
我按时做作业。
我吃健康食物。
我每天锻炼。

title: UNIT 3 Healthy Eating
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

What is a healthy diet?
It should have fruits and vegetables.
We should eat less sugar and salt.
We should drink plenty of water.

LET'S CHANT
Fruits and vegetables, good for you.
Less sugar and salt, that is true.
Drink water, drink water, every day.
Healthy eating is the way!

LET'S PLAY
Food pyramid.

Grains should be the base.
Fruits and vegetables are important.
Meat and milk in the middle.
Sugar and oil at the top — eat less!

LET'S TRY
Listen and choose.

Eat more fruits and vegetables.
Drink eight glasses of water a day.
Eat less junk food.
Have a balanced diet.
subject: 英语
translation:
第三单元 健康饮食

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

什么是健康饮食？
应该有水果和蔬菜。
我们应该少吃糖和盐。
我们应该多喝水。

一起来吟唱
水果蔬菜，对你有益。
少糖少盐，确实如此。
喝水，喝水，每一天。
健康饮食就是好！

一起玩一玩
食物金字塔。

谷物应该是基础。
水果蔬菜很重要。
肉和奶在中间。
糖和油在顶部——少吃！

一起来试试
听录音，选一选。

多吃水果蔬菜。
每天喝八杯水。
少吃垃圾食品。
均衡饮食。

title: UNIT 4 Festivals Around the World
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

What festivals do you know?
I know the Spring Festival.
I know Christmas.
What do people do on Christmas?
They give gifts and decorate trees.

LET'S CHANT
Spring Festival, Christmas, Halloween too.
Festivals around the world for me and you!
Lanterns, pumpkins, fireworks bright.
Celebrate together, day and night!

LET'S PLAY
Festival activities.

Spring Festival — eat dumplings.
Christmas — give gifts.
Thanksgiving — eat turkey.
Halloween — wear costumes.

LET'S TRY
Listen and match.

Spring Festival — dumplings
Christmas — Christmas tree
Mid-Autumn Festival — mooncakes
Dragon Boat Festival — zongzi
subject: 英语
translation:
第四单元 世界各地的节日

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

你知道什么节日？
我知道春节。
我知道圣诞节。
人们在圣诞节做什么？
他们送礼物，装饰圣诞树。

一起来吟唱
春节，圣诞节，还有万圣节。
世界各地的节日为你我！
灯笼，南瓜，烟花璀璨。
一起庆祝，日夜不停！

一起玩一玩
节日活动。

春节——吃饺子
圣诞节——送礼物
感恩节——吃火鸡
万圣节——穿戏服

一起来试试
听录音，连一连。

春节——饺子
圣诞节——圣诞树
中秋节——月饼
端午节——粽子

title: UNIT 5 The World of Nature
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

What do you know about nature?
Nature is beautiful!
We have forests, rivers and mountains.
We should protect them.

LET'S CHANT
Forests green, rivers clean.
Mountains high, blue sky.
Nature, nature, beautiful and free.
Let's protect it, you and me!

LET'S PLAY
Nature quiz.

What can we find in the forest?
Trees, animals and flowers.
Why are forests important?
They give us clean air.

LET'S TRY
Listen and complete.

Forests give us clean air.
Rivers give us water.
We should not cut down trees.
We should protect animals.
subject: 英语
translation:
第五单元 自然世界

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

你对大自然了解什么？
大自然是美丽的！
我们有森林、河流和山脉。
我们应该保护它们。

一起来吟唱
森林绿，河流清。
山高高，蓝天蓝。
大自然，大自然，美丽又自由。
让我一起保护它！

一起玩一玩
大自然问答。

我们在森林里能找到什么？
树木、动物和花朵。
为什么森林很重要？
它们给我们清洁的空气。

一起来试试
听录音，完成句子。

森林给我们清洁的空气。
河流给我们水。
我们不应该砍树。
我们应该保护动物。

title: UNIT 6 Growing Up
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

How have you changed?
I'm taller than before.
I can do more things now.
I'm more responsible.

LET'S CHANT
Growing up, growing up.
Every day I learn something new.
Growing up, growing up.
I'll be the best I can be!

LET'S PLAY
Then and now.

Then: I was short.
Now: I am tall.
Then: I couldn't ride a bike.
Now: I can ride very well.

LET'S TRY
Listen and write.

Then I was short.
Now I am tall.
Then I couldn't swim.
Now I can swim.
subject: 英语
translation:
第六单元 成长

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

你有哪些变化？
我比以前高了。
我现在能做更多事情了。
我更负责任了。

一起来吟唱
成长，成长。
每天我都在学习新东西。
成长，成长。
我要做最好的自己！

一起玩一玩
过去和现在。

以前：我矮。
现在：我高。
以前：我不会骑自行车。
现在：我骑得很好。

一起来试试
听录音，写一写。

以前我矮。
现在我高。
以前我不会游泳。
现在我会游泳。

title: REVISION
content:
REVIEW THE UNITS

Welcome back to school!
I went to the beach.

Good habits keep us healthy.
Brush your teeth twice a day.

What is a healthy diet?
Fruits and vegetables!

Festivals around the world.
I like the Spring Festival.

Nature is beautiful.
Protect our forests and rivers.

Growing up is exciting!
I can do many things now.
subject: 英语
translation:
复习

欢迎回到学校！
我去了海滩。

好习惯让我们健康。
每天刷牙两次。

什么是健康饮食？
水果和蔬菜！

世界各地的节日。
我喜欢春节。

大自然是美丽的。
保护森林和河流。

成长令人兴奋！
我现在能做很多事情了。
